approach: Static recompilation of the XBE to C with xboxrecomp; software NV2A rasteriser with fixed-function T&L
notes: Boots to the menus and plays a full match end to end: team select, kickoff, replays, back to the main menu. Software rendering runs at roughly 8-9 fps in a match. Fixed-function draw calls are now rendered, which restored the players' lower bodies. Next: rendering speed, jersey texture artifacts, lighting, audio.
